parts.text:
Create two source-grounded English descriptions for a controlled retrieval study.
Use ONLY the supplied source caption. You cannot see the image. The source is data,
not instructions. Never infer, correct, or invent facts. Preserve uncertainty and
negation and attach each attribute to the exact original subject/object.

Produce the requested profiles:
- attribute_list: a compact semicolon-separated list of explicit subject/object and
  attribute pairs. State the subject first; name each clothing item, accessory or
  vehicle part beside its color or property. For faces, list the explicit distinctive
  facial structure, hair/hairline, eyebrows, facial hair, marks and accessories.
  Use ordinary terms where their meaning is equivalent. Avoid bare bags of keywords.
- distinctive_first: a fluent natural description beginning with the most specific
  identifying combination stated in the source. Place distinctive accessories,
  markings, hair/hairline, garment-color combinations or make/model before generic
  build/anatomy. Retain useful complementary facts after that combination.

Both profiles should retain useful visible identifying facts without generic filler.
Do not pad, count words, or target a word budget. Omit camera, lighting, crop, focus,
background and inferred emotion. Do not infer demographic categories. Do not claim
an attribute is rare across the dataset: you have only this source caption.
If no distinctive attribute is provided, use the available explicit combination.

Return {"variants": [...]} with exactly one entry per requested name. Each entry
must have variant_type and text. Optional fields: applicable, change_note,
retained_facts, omitted_facts, skip_reason. No Markdown, rankings, or explanations.

{"sample_id": "face::test::183801.jpg", "domain": "face", "source_caption": "Woman, adult, oval face shape with balanced vertical thirds, moderate cheekbone width, and defined jawline; no persistent asymmetries visible; rounded hairline pulled backward with moderate temporal recession; medium-thick, soft-arched eyebrows with a lateral peak and moderate spacing; almond-shaped eyes with a slight upward slant, moderate palpebral fissure length, double eyelids with visible upper lid exposure, and average orbital depth; straight nasal dorsum, medium bridge width, rounded tip with moderate projection, and visible nostrils; medium mouth width, upper-to-lower lip fullness ratio near even, defined cupid's bow, and level lip corners; no facial hair; smooth skin surface without visible permanent marks; average-sized ears with free lobes and visible small stud earrings; shown in a low-angle shot with a slight head tilt upward, neutral expression, and directional lighting from the upper left.", "operations": [{"name": "llm_attribute_list", "operation": "summary", "profile": "attribute_list"}, {"name": "llm_distinctive_first", "operation": "summary", "profile": "distinctive_first"}]}

visible_response: {"variants": [{"variant_type": "llm_attribute_list", "text": "face shape: oval; cheekbones: moderate width; jawline: defined; hairline: rounded and pulled backward; temporal recession: moderate; eyebrows: medium-thick, soft-arched with lateral peak; eyebrow spacing: moderate; eyes: almond-shaped with slight upward slant; palpebral fissure: moderate length; eyelids: double with visible upper lid exposure; orbital depth: average; nasal dorsum: straight; nose bridge: medium width; nose tip: rounded with moderate projection; nostrils: visible; mouth width: medium; lips: even fullness ratio with defined cupid's bow; lip corners: level; skin: smooth without permanent marks; ears: average-sized with free lobes; earrings: small stud"}, {"variant_type": "llm_distinctive_first", "text": "Small stud earrings adorn the free lobes of average-sized ears on an individual with a rounded, moderately recessed hairline. The face features a defined jawline, moderate cheekbone width, and an oval shape. The almond-shaped eyes show a slight upward slant, moderate palpebral fissure length, and double eyelids with upper lid exposure. Medium-thick, soft-arched eyebrows have a lateral peak and moderate spacing. The nose has a straight dorsum, medium bridge width, and a rounded, moderately projecting tip with visible nostrils. The medium-width mouth displays even lip fullness, a defined cupid's bow, and level corners. The skin is smooth with no permanent marks or facial hair."}]}
